scope.nonApplicableBoundary: This mixed-package sidecar applies only to the exact COL26.8 Porifera B8TXQ and Cnidaria CN2 usage roots. The package has no additional strict accepted-species roots; all COL26.8 species outside these two roots, including other Animalia and non-species records, are non-applicable and are not emitted.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Porifera/Cnidaria species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Porifera/Cnidaria species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Porifera/Cnidaria species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Porifera/Cnidaria species.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk for the declared Porifera and Cnidaria partitions only. It is not a final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier, fossil record or expert-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车仅为明确声明的海绵动物与刺胞动物分区提供冻结的严格命名交叉映射。它不是最终分类权威、系统发育、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案、化石记录或专家审阅记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; one detail query loads exactly one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned. The complete ITIS-only current-species partition is in one immutable JSONL gzip shard.
